```{r}
required_packages <- c(
  "edgeR",
  "limma",
  "dplyr",
  "tibble",
  "tidyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "fs",
  "knitr",
  "BiocParallel"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required packages are not installed: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fs)
library(knitr)

params <- list(
  clinical_file = "data/ucec_clinical.csv",
  counts_file = "data/UCEC/count_gene_name.csv",
  output_dir = "data/DE_results/ucec_gene_DE",
  bootstrap_iterations = 500L,
  random_seed = 20260804L,
  fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  sign_consistency_threshold = 0.90,
  repeated_significance_threshold = 0.70,
  parallel_workers = 23L
)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = TRUE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6
)

set.seed(params$random_seed)

clinical_file <- params$clinical_file
counts_file <- params$counts_file
res_dir <- params$output_dir
stability_dir <- file.path(res_dir, "stability_analysis")

fs::dir_create(res_dir)
fs::dir_create(stability_dir)

fdr_threshold <- params$fdr_threshold
```

```{r}
if (!file.exists(clinical_file)) {
  stop("Clinical-data file does not exist: ", clinical_file)
}

clinical_data <- read.csv(
  clinical_file,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  na.strings = c("NA", "")
)

required_clinical_columns <- c(
  "sample_submitter_id",
  "MSI_TMB"
)

missing_clinical_columns <- setdiff(
  required_clinical_columns,
  colnames(clinical_data)
)

if (length(missing_clinical_columns) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required clinical-data columns: ",
    paste(missing_clinical_columns, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (anyDuplicated(clinical_data$sample_submitter_id)) {
  duplicated_ids <- unique(
    clinical_data$sample_submitter_id[
      duplicated(clinical_data$sample_submitter_id)
    ]
  )

  stop(
    "Duplicated sample_submitter_id values were found: ",
    paste(head(duplicated_ids, 20), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

rownames(clinical_data) <- clinical_data$sample_submitter_id
```

```{r}
  levels = c(
    "MSI_H",

    "MSS_TMB_L"
```

```{r}
fit_edger_model <- function(
    counts_mat,
    metadata,
    genes_to_keep = NULL
) {
  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(counts_mat),
      rownames(metadata)
    )
  )

  expected_levels <- c(
    "MSI_H",
    "MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS_TMB_L"
  )

  group <- factor(
    as.character(metadata$MSI_TMB),
    levels = expected_levels
  )

  if (anyNA(group)) {
    stop(
      "Some samples have a missing or unsupported MSI_TMB group."
    )
  }

  current_group_sizes <- table(group)

  if (any(current_group_sizes == 0)) {
    stop(
      "At least one MSI/TMB group is absent from this dataset."
    )
  }

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts = counts_mat,
    group = group
  )

  if (is.null(genes_to_keep)) {
    keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(
      y,
      group = group,
      min.count = 10
    )
  } else {
    keep <- rownames(y) %in% genes_to_keep &
      rowSums(y$counts) > 0
  }

  y <- y[
    keep,
    ,
    keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(y) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No expressed genes remain after filtering."
    )
  }

  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(
    y,
    method = "TMM"
  )

  design <- stats::model.matrix(
    ~ 0 + group
  )

  colnames(design) <- levels(group)

  y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(
    y,
    design,
    robust = TRUE
  )

  fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(
    y,
    design,
    robust = TRUE
  )

  contrasts <- list(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H = limma::makeContrasts(
      MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H,
      levels = design
    ),
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = limma::makeContrasts(
      MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L,
      levels = design
    ),
    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L = limma::makeContrasts(
      MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L,
      levels = design
    )
  )

  list(
    y = y,
    fit = fit,
    design = design,
    contrasts = contrasts,
    kept_genes = rownames(y)
  )
}
```

```{r}
extract_contrast_results <- function(model_object) {
  lapply(
    model_object$contrasts,
    function(contrast_vector) {
      qlf <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(
        model_object$fit,
        contrast = contrast_vector
      )

      edgeR::topTags(
        qlf,
        n = Inf,
        sort.by = "PValue"
      )$table
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
stratified_bootstrap_indices <- function(group) {
  group <- droplevels(group)

  unlist(
    lapply(
      levels(group),
      function(group_name) {
        available_indices <- which(
          group == group_name
        )

        sample(
          available_indices,
          size = length(available_indices),
          replace = TRUE
        )
      }
    ),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
run_resampling_analysis <- function(
    index_list,
    resample_names,
    counts_mat,
    metadata,
    genes_to_keep,
    target_genes,
    contrasts_to_test,
    fdr_cutoff = 0.05
) {
  n_resamples <- length(index_list)

  stopifnot(
    length(resample_names) == n_resamples
  )

  logFC_matrices <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

        matrix(
          NA_real_,
          nrow = length(genes),
          ncol = n_resamples,
          dimnames = list(
            genes,
            resample_names
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  FDR_matrices <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

        matrix(
          NA_real_,
          nrow = length(genes),
          ncol = n_resamples,
          dimnames = list(
            genes,
            resample_names
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  total_DE <- matrix(
    NA_integer_,
    nrow = n_resamples,
    ncol = length(contrasts_to_test),
    dimnames = list(
      resample_names,
      contrasts_to_test
    )
  )

  failure_messages <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    n_resamples
  )

  for (i in seq_len(n_resamples)) {
    if (
      i == 1L ||
      i %% 25L == 0L ||
      i == n_resamples
    ) {
      message(
        "Processing resample ",
        i,
        " of ",
        n_resamples
      )
    }

    sample_indices <- index_list[[i]]

    counts_i <- counts_mat[
      genes_to_keep,
      sample_indices,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    metadata_i <- metadata[
      sample_indices,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    unique_names <- paste0(
      "resample_",
      i,
      "_sample_",
      seq_len(ncol(counts_i))
    )

    colnames(counts_i) <- unique_names
    rownames(metadata_i) <- unique_names

    model_i <- try(
      fit_edger_model(
        counts_mat = counts_i,
        metadata = metadata_i,
        genes_to_keep = genes_to_keep
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    if (inherits(model_i, "try-error")) {
      failure_messages[i] <- as.character(model_i)
      next
    }

    for (contrast_name in contrasts_to_test) {
      qlf_i <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(
        model_i$fit,
        contrast = model_i$contrasts[[contrast_name]]
      )

      tab_i <- qlf_i$table

      tab_i$FDR <- p.adjust(
        tab_i$PValue,
        method = "BH"
      )

      total_DE[i, contrast_name] <- sum(
        tab_i$FDR <= fdr_cutoff,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

      if (length(genes) == 0) {
        next
      }

      gene_positions <- match(
        genes,
        rownames(tab_i)
      )

      logFC_matrices[[contrast_name]][, i] <-
        tab_i$logFC[gene_positions]

      FDR_matrices[[contrast_name]][, i] <-
        tab_i$FDR[gene_positions]
    }
  }

  list(
    logFC = logFC_matrices,
    FDR = FDR_matrices,
    total_DE = total_DE,
    failures = failure_messages
  )
}
run_resampling_parallel <- function(
    index_list,
    resample_names,
    counts_mat,
    metadata,
    genes_to_keep,
    target_genes,
    contrasts_to_test,
    fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
    n_cores = 4,
    random_seed = 20260804
) {
  if (!requireNamespace("BiocParallel", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Install BiocParallel using: ",
      "BiocManager::install('BiocParallel')"
    )
  }

  n_resamples <- length(index_list)
  n_cores <- min(n_cores, n_resamples)
  
  batch_size <- 5L

  batch_ids <- split(
    seq_len(n_resamples),
    ceiling(seq_len(n_resamples) / batch_size)
  )
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

  bp <- BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(
    workers = n_cores,
    RNGseed = random_seed,
    progressbar = TRUE
  )

  parts <- BiocParallel::bplapply(
    batch_ids,
    function(ids) {
      suppressMessages(
        run_resampling_analysis(
          index_list = index_list[ids],
          resample_names = resample_names[ids],
          counts_mat = counts_mat,
          metadata = metadata,
          genes_to_keep = genes_to_keep,
          target_genes = target_genes,
          contrasts_to_test = contrasts_to_test,
          fdr_cutoff = fdr_cutoff
        )
      )
    },
    BPPARAM = bp
  )

  logFC_combined <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        do.call(
          cbind,
          lapply(
            parts,
            function(x) {
              x$logFC[[contrast_name]]
            }
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  FDR_combined <- setNames(
    lapply(
      contrasts_to_test,
      function(contrast_name) {
        do.call(
          cbind,
          lapply(
            parts,
            function(x) {
              x$FDR[[contrast_name]]
            }
          )
        )
      }
    ),
    contrasts_to_test
  )

  list(
    logFC = logFC_combined,
    FDR = FDR_combined,
    total_DE = do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(parts, function(x) x$total_DE)
    ),
    failures = unlist(
      lapply(parts, function(x) x$failures),
      use.names = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
safe_quantile <- function(
    x,
    probability
) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  unname(
    stats::quantile(
      x,
      probs = probability,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      type = 6
    )
  )
}


safe_median <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  stats::median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}


summarize_resampling <- function(
    resampling_results,
    full_results,
    target_genes,
    method_name,
    fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
    sign_consistency_cutoff = 0.90,
    repeated_significance_cutoff = 0.70
) {
  summaries <- lapply(
    names(target_genes),
    function(contrast_name) {
      genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

      if (length(genes) == 0) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      logFC_matrix <-
        resampling_results$logFC[[contrast_name]]

      FDR_matrix <-
        resampling_results$FDR[[contrast_name]]

      full_table <- full_results[[contrast_name]][
        genes,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]

      full_logFC <- full_table$logFC
      full_FDR <- full_table$FDR

      valid_result <-
        !is.na(logFC_matrix) &
        !is.na(FDR_matrix)

      same_direction <- sweep(
        sign(logFC_matrix),
        MARGIN = 1,
        STATS = sign(full_logFC),
        FUN = "=="
      )

      significant <- FDR_matrix <= fdr_cutoff

      n_tested <- rowSums(valid_result)

      sign_consistency <- ifelse(
        n_tested > 0,
        rowSums(
          same_direction & valid_result,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_tested,
        NA_real_
      )

      FDR_rate <- ifelse(
        n_tested > 0,
        rowSums(
          significant & valid_result,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_tested,
        NA_real_
      )

      FDR_same_direction_rate <- ifelse(
        n_tested > 0,
        rowSums(
          significant &
            same_direction &
            valid_result,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_tested,
        NA_real_
      )

      median_logFC <- apply(
        logFC_matrix,
        1,
        safe_median
      )

      logFC_q025 <- apply(
        logFC_matrix,
        1,
        safe_quantile,
        probability = 0.025
      )

      logFC_q975 <- apply(
        logFC_matrix,
        1,
        safe_quantile,
        probability = 0.975
      )

      direction_stable <-
        (
          logFC_q025 > 0 &
            logFC_q975 > 0
        ) |
        (
          logFC_q025 < 0 &
            logFC_q975 < 0
        )

      tibble(
        Contrast = contrast_name,
        Gene = genes,
        Method = method_name,
        n_resamples = ncol(logFC_matrix),
        n_tested = n_tested,
        tested_rate = n_tested / ncol(logFC_matrix),
        full_logFC = full_logFC,
        full_FDR = full_FDR,
        resampled_median_logFC = median_logFC,
        resampled_logFC_q025 = logFC_q025,
        resampled_logFC_q975 = logFC_q975,
        sign_consistency = sign_consistency,
        FDR_rate = FDR_rate,
        FDR_same_direction_rate =
          FDR_same_direction_rate,
        direction_stable = direction_stable,
        robust_effect =
          tested_rate >= 0.95 &
          sign_consistency >=
            sign_consistency_cutoff &
          direction_stable,
        repeatedly_significant =
          FDR_same_direction_rate >=
            repeated_significance_cutoff
      )
    }
  )

  bind_rows(summaries)
}
```

```{r}
significant_results <- lapply(
  names(results),
  function(contrast_name) {
    results[[contrast_name]] %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column(
        var = "Gene"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(FDR),
        FDR <= fdr_threshold
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        desc(abs(logFC))
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Contrast = contrast_name,
        Regulation_in_first_group = case_when(
          logFC > 0 ~ "Upregulated",
          logFC < 0 ~ "Downregulated",
          TRUE ~ "No_change"
        ),
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

names(significant_results) <- names(results)

for (contrast_name in names(significant_results)) {
  write.csv(
    significant_results[[contrast_name]],
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      paste0(
        contrast_name,
        "_sig_genes.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

all_significant_results <- bind_rows(
  significant_results
)

write.csv(
  all_significant_results,
  file.path(
    res_dir,
    "all_contrasts_significant_genes.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
for (contrast_name in names(significant_results)) {
  df <- significant_results[[contrast_name]]

  parts <- unlist(
    strsplit(
      contrast_name,
      "_vs_",
      fixed = TRUE
    )
  )

  if (length(parts) != 2) {
    warning(
      "Could not parse contrast name: ",
      contrast_name
    )
    next
  }

  group1 <- parts[1]
  group2 <- parts[2]

  df_up_group1 <- df %>%
    filter(logFC > 0) %>%
    transmute(
      Gene,
      logFC
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(logFC)
    )

  df_down_group1 <- df %>%
    filter(logFC < 0) %>%
    transmute(
      Gene,
      logFC
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      logFC
    )

  df_up_group2 <- df %>%
    filter(logFC < 0) %>%
    transmute(
      Gene,
      logFC = -logFC
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(logFC)
    )

  df_down_group2 <- df %>%
    filter(logFC > 0) %>%
    transmute(
      Gene,
      logFC = -logFC
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      logFC
    )

  output_directories <- c(
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group1,
      "upregulated"
    ),
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group1,
      "downregulated"
    ),
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group2,
      "upregulated"
    ),
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group2,
      "downregulated"
    )
  )

  fs::dir_create(
    output_directories
  )

  write.csv(
    df_up_group1,
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group1,
      "upregulated",
      paste0(
        "compared_to_",
        group2,
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    df_down_group1,
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group1,
      "downregulated",
      paste0(
        "compared_to_",
        group2,
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    df_up_group2,
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group2,
      "upregulated",
      paste0(
        "compared_to_",
        group1,
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  write.csv(
    df_down_group2,
    file.path(
      res_dir,
      group2,
      "downregulated",
      paste0(
        "compared_to_",
        group1,
        ".csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
stability_contrasts <- c(
  "MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H",
  "MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L"
)

target_genes <- lapply(
  results[stability_contrasts],
  function(result_table) {
    rownames(result_table)[
      !is.na(result_table$FDR) &
        result_table$FDR <= fdr_threshold
    ]
  }
)

target_gene_counts <- tibble(
  Contrast = names(target_genes),
  Number_of_primary_DEGs = vapply(
    target_genes,
    length,
    integer(1)
  )
)

    "target_gene_counts.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

)
```

```{r}
set.seed(params$random_seed)

B <- as.integer(
  params$bootstrap_iterations
)

if (B < 1L) {
  stop(
    "bootstrap_iterations must be at least 1."
  )
}

bootstrap_index_list <- replicate(
  B,
  stratified_bootstrap_indices(
    clinical_data$MSI_TMB
  ),
  simplify = FALSE
)

bootstrap_names <- sprintf(
  "bootstrap_%04d",
  seq_len(B)
)

counts_bootstrap <- counts[
  primary_model$kept_genes,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
bootstrap_results <- run_resampling_parallel(
  index_list = bootstrap_index_list,
  resample_names = bootstrap_names,
  counts_mat = counts,
  metadata = clinical_data,
  genes_to_keep = primary_model$kept_genes,
  target_genes = target_genes,
  contrasts_to_test = stability_contrasts,
  fdr_cutoff = fdr_threshold,
  n_cores = params$parallel_workers,
  random_seed = params$random_seed
)

saveRDS(
  bootstrap_results,
  file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "bootstrap_results.rds"
  )
)
```

```{r}
mss_tmb_h_indices <- which(
  clinical_data$MSI_TMB ==
    "MSS_TMB_H"
)

all_sample_indices <- seq_len(
  ncol(counts)
)

loo_index_list <- lapply(
  mss_tmb_h_indices,
  function(index_to_remove) {
    all_sample_indices[
      all_sample_indices !=
        index_to_remove
    ]
  }
)

loo_names <- paste0(
  "left_out_",
  rownames(clinical_data)[
    mss_tmb_h_indices
  ]
)

loo_results <- run_resampling_analysis(
  index_list = loo_index_list,
  resample_names = loo_names,
  counts_mat = counts,
  metadata = clinical_data,
  genes_to_keep = primary_model$kept_genes,
  target_genes = target_genes,
  contrasts_to_test = stability_contrasts,
  fdr_cutoff = fdr_threshold
)

saveRDS(
  loo_results,
  file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "leave_one_MSS_TMB_H_out_results.rds"
  )
)
```

```{r}
bootstrap_summary <- summarize_resampling(
  resampling_results = bootstrap_results,
  full_results = results,
  target_genes = target_genes,
  method_name = "Stratified bootstrap",
  fdr_cutoff = fdr_threshold,
  sign_consistency_cutoff =
    params$sign_consistency_threshold,
  repeated_significance_cutoff =
    params$repeated_significance_threshold
)

loo_summary <- summarize_resampling(
  resampling_results = loo_results,
  full_results = results,
  target_genes = target_genes,
  method_name = "Leave-one-MSS/TMB-H-out",
  fdr_cutoff = fdr_threshold,
  sign_consistency_cutoff =
    params$sign_consistency_threshold,
  repeated_significance_cutoff =
    params$repeated_significance_threshold
)

stability_summary <- bind_rows(
  bootstrap_summary,
  loo_summary
) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    Gene,
    Method
  )

write.csv(
  bootstrap_summary,
  file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "bootstrap_gene_stability_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  loo_summary,
  file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "leave_one_out_gene_stability_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  stability_summary,
  file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "DEG_resampling_stability_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
bootstrap_wide <- bootstrap_summary %>%
  select(
    Contrast,
    Gene,
    bootstrap_tested_rate = tested_rate,
    bootstrap_median_logFC =
      resampled_median_logFC,
    bootstrap_logFC_q025 =
      resampled_logFC_q025,
    bootstrap_logFC_q975 =
      resampled_logFC_q975,
    bootstrap_sign_consistency =
      sign_consistency,
    bootstrap_FDR_rate =
      FDR_rate,
    bootstrap_FDR_same_direction_rate =
      FDR_same_direction_rate,
    bootstrap_direction_stable =
      direction_stable,
    bootstrap_robust_effect =
      robust_effect,
    bootstrap_repeatedly_significant =
      repeatedly_significant
  )

loo_wide <- loo_summary %>%
  select(
    Contrast,
    Gene,
    loo_tested_rate = tested_rate,
    loo_median_logFC =
      resampled_median_logFC,
    loo_logFC_q025 =
      resampled_logFC_q025,
    loo_logFC_q975 =
      resampled_logFC_q975,
    loo_sign_consistency =
      sign_consistency,
    loo_FDR_rate =
      FDR_rate,
    loo_FDR_same_direction_rate =
      FDR_same_direction_rate,
    loo_direction_stable =
      direction_stable,
    loo_robust_effect =
      robust_effect,
    loo_repeatedly_significant =
      repeatedly_significant
  )

full_gene_information <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    stability_contrasts,
    function(contrast_name) {
      genes <- target_genes[[contrast_name]]

      if (length(genes) == 0) {
        return(tibble())
      }

      results[[contrast_name]][
        genes,
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ] %>%
        rownames_to_column(
          var = "Gene"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Contrast = contrast_name,
          .before = 1
        )
    }
  )
)

combined_stability_table <- full_gene_information %>%
  left_join(
    bootstrap_wide,
    by = c(
      "Contrast",
      "Gene"
    )
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    loo_wide,
    by = c(
      "Contrast",
      "Gene"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stable_in_both_analyses =
      bootstrap_robust_effect &
        loo_robust_effect,
    repeatedly_significant_in_both =
      bootstrap_repeatedly_significant &
        loo_repeatedly_significant
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Contrast,
    FDR,
    desc(abs(logFC))
  )

write.csv(
  combined_stability_table,
  file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "combined_primary_bootstrap_LOO_stability.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
bootstrap_plot_data <- bootstrap_summary %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(resampled_median_logFC)
  )

bootstrap_logFC_plot <- ggplot(
  bootstrap_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = full_logFC,
    y = resampled_median_logFC
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      size = FDR_same_direction_rate,
      shape = direction_stable
    ),
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Contrast,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap stability of differential-expression effect sizes",
    x = "Primary-analysis logFC",
    y = "Median bootstrap logFC",
    size = paste0(
      "Same-direction\nFDR <= ",
      fdr_threshold,
      " rate"
    ),
    shape = "95% bootstrap interval\nexcludes zero"
  )

print(
  bootstrap_logFC_plot
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "bootstrap_logFC_stability.svg"
  ),
  plot = bootstrap_logFC_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    stability_dir,
    "bootstrap_logFC_stability.png"
  ),
  plot = bootstrap_logFC_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
stability_rate_plot_data <- stability_summary %>%
  select(
    Contrast,
    Gene,
    Method,
    sign_consistency,
```
